items.problem: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor hard-fails for MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md sections that lack an <a id> anchor (manifest checklist, appxmanifest, WUI analyzer, PackageReference cheat-sheet, namespace mapping, etc.) and its not-found error lists no valid anchors, so the agent cannot self-correct and falls back to grepping/opening the whole patterns file.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 18-20: three consecutive 'Anchor not found' failures for -Anchor manifest / manifest-migration-checklist / appxmanifest; turns 21-22 recovered only by grepping every heading and opening the file by line range.
items.root_cause: The retrieval helper indexes the doc by <a id> only, but the doc mixes anchored and unanchored sections; the miss path offers no discovery affordance, contradicting SKILL.md's 'prefer this over opening MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md directly'.
items.change: Enhanced scripts/Get-MigrationPattern.ps1: (1) after the exact <a id> match fails, fall back to matching a ##/### heading by slug (exact, then substring), terminating a heading-started section at the next heading of equal-or-higher level; (2) on a total miss, Write-Error now lists every available <a id> anchor AND heading slug. Backward-compatible: existing <a id> anchors (threading, csproj, ...) behave exactly as before.
items.expected_effect: Every documented section is reachable by name, near-miss anchor guesses resolve, and a genuine miss self-corrects in one turn instead of pushing the agent to open the API-name-dense file wholesale (the content-filter/context risk the script exists to avoid).
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest` (and appxmanifest / manifest-migration-checklist) exits 0 and returns the manifest section; the build log shows zero 'Anchor not found' errors followed by a wholesale heading grep. Verified locally: all three previously-failing anchors now exit 0; a bogus anchor prints the full anchor+heading list.
